card.name: Mid-sentence words in patient-facing medical text
card.fires_on: Negative pole on varied words inside medical sentences, such as the 'ca' in Precautions, 'clinical' after 'without', 'physician' after 'your', and 'patient' ending a phrase. No single word type unites them.

modes.label: Inside Precautions
modes.description: The 'ca' partway through the word Precautions in warning cross-references.

modes.label: Medical nouns after linking words
modes.description: Words such as clinical, physician, patient or risks that follow a small linking word in advice or warning sentences.
modes.example: Notify your<< physician>> if you are pregnant or suspect you may
